mapper.select: SELECT id, alert_active, alert_sent, last_indicator, last_description, last_checked_at, last_changed_at, last_alerted_at, last_recovered_at, updated_at FROM openai_status_state WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openai_status_state ( id, alert_active, alert_sent, last_indicator, last_description, last_checked_at, last_changed_at, last_alerted_at, last_recovered_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{alertActive}, #{alertSent}, #{lastIndicator}, #{lastDescription}, #{lastCheckedAt}, #{lastChangedAt}, #{lastAlertedAt}, #{lastRecoveredAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET alert_active = EXCLUDED.alert_active, alert_sent = EXCLUDED.alert_sent, last_indicator = EXCLUDED.last_indicator, last_description = EXCLUDED.last_description, last_checked_at = EXCLUDED.last_checked_at, last_changed_at = EXCLUDED.last_changed_at, last_alerted_at = EXCLUDED.last_alerted_at, last_recovered_at = EXCLUDED.last_recovered_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
